map.Bishop 宫颈成熟度评分 = 宫口扩张 + 宫颈消退 + 先露位置 + 宫颈: Bishop cervical maturity score = dilatation + effacement + station + position + consistency (each 0–3), max 13; ≥8 mature (high induction success), 6–8 fairly mature, <6 immature needing cervical ripening.
map.注：改良Bishop评分(位置/质地最高2分)总分0–13分。Bishop评分低: Note: the modified Bishop score (position/consistency max 2 each) totals 0–13. A low Bishop score raises induction failure and cesarean rates, with higher predictive value in nulliparae.
map.提示：Bishop评分是评估宫颈成熟度最经典的方法。评分≥6为宫颈成熟，引产成功: Tip: the Bishop score is the classic method to assess cervical maturity. A score ≥6 means mature with high induction success; ≤5 needs ripening first (e.g. dinoprostone, misoprostol, Foley balloon). For clinical reference only.

map.宫口开大 3cm（3分）、宫颈管消退 100%（3分）、先露-1（2分）、宫颈中: Dilatation 3 cm (3 pts), effacement 100% (3 pts), station −1 (2 pts), moderate (1 pt), anterior (2 pts): total 3+3+2+1+2 = 11/13, ≥8 mature with high induction success.
map.宫口 0cm（0分）、宫颈管消退 30%（1分）、先露-3（0分）、宫颈后（0分: Dilatation 0 cm (0 pts), effacement 30% (1 pt), station −3 (0 pts), posterior (0 pts), firm (0 pts): total 1, <6 needs ripening first.
map.≥8 分视为宫颈成熟，可直接缩宫素引产；6–7 分成功率较高；<6 分建议先促宫: ≥8 is considered mature and allows direct oxytocin induction; 6–7 has higher success; <6 suggests ripening agents (prostaglandins) before re-evaluation.
map.满分 13 分，由宫口开大、宫颈管消退、先露高低、宫颈硬度、宫颈位置五项组成，每: The max is 13, from five items—dilatation, effacement, station, consistency, position—each scored 0–2 or 0–3.
